Context: 29. Postaf Tariff and Savi:ngs Schemes

| 15-year Public Provident Fund Account (PPF) | 7.1 % per annum (compounded yearly). | Minimum INR ~ 500. Maximum INR ~ 1,50,000 in a Financial Year. | Deposits qualify for deduction from income under Section 80-C of IT Act. |
| National Savings Certificates (NSC) | 7.7 % compounded annually but payable at maturity. | Minimum of ~ 1,000 and in multiples of ~ 100. No Maximum limit. | Deposits qualify for tax rebate under Section 80-C of IT Act. |
